The meeting record contains no national explanations of vote. [VOTE] The Council extended UNAMI's existing mandate through 31 May 2024. [TERM] At Iraq's request, the mission was to support inclusive dialogue and reconciliation, with women's meaningful participation and civil-society and youth input. [REVIEW] Its consultations were to include Iraq, Kuwait and civil society. [CONSULT] The review was to assess the continued relevance of UNAMI tasks, recommend changes to its mandate, structure and staffing, and consider how to help Iraq strengthen regional cooperation. [SCOPE] Separately, the Secretary-General was asked to report to the Council every four months. [REPORT]
